summary: This bill amends the Export-Import Bank Act of 1945 to exclude certain financing from the calculation of the default rate, specifically for entities that replace or compete with products or services from entities on U.S. government blacklists or those involved in the Program on China and Transformational Exports.

scores.thoughts: This bill aims to strengthen U.S. exports by modifying how the Export-Import Bank calculates default rates, specifically to support financing that competes with entities from China or those on U.S. sanctions lists. This directly promotes U.S. export competitiveness and is a form of strategic trade policy, leaning towards supporting domestic industry in international trade.
